# Terminate Processing

A `Contract` type concerning termination of processing. It declares `cause` and `reason` for termination context and inherits `order` from `Contract`. The supplied definitions do not establish their detailed meanings, required values or defaults.

The execution specification is not included, so termination triggers, scope, effects and rejection rules remain unspecified here. Presence of this type alone does not confirm that processing has stopped.
